ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) with distinct high-intensity (white) regions at the lateral tips and scattered speckling; macro-ratio estimated at approximately 80:20 dark to light.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous white region on the left lateral tip with dense micro-mottling; right lateral tip contains three distinct high-intensity vertical bands; sparse high-intensity speckling concentrated in the lower central and left quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible U-shaped central depression with a wide aperture, characterized by a rounded base and symmetrical divergence of the lobe margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency pixel variations; multiple distinct jagged peaks and valleys (serrations) visible along the entire continuous boundary from notch to tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upward concave-to-convex curve trajectory from the median notch to the lateral tips, terminating in sharp, slightly hooked apexes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across the lower central fluke and the inner margin of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent parallel vertical dark linear disruptions on the right lobe; multiple thin, unaligned white linear streaks visible on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent vertical rake marks on the right lobe; irregular, possibly eroded tissue margins at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense 'salt and pepper' high-intensity pixel distribution on the outer margin of the left lobe, distinct from the solid banding on the right lobe.
